counterfactual_families.causal_claim: The second-close confirmation waits one completed session too long after an individual MA30 breach.
counterfactual_families.decision_point: First completed close below its own MA30.
counterfactual_families.exact_intervention: Replace the frozen MA30 x2 trigger with a first-breach trigger and preserve next-eligible-open execution.
counterfactual_families.falsification_criterion: The claimed delay mechanism is not broad if first-to-second-confirmation path loss is mixed or too small relative to loss already present before the second close.
counterfactual_families.potential_right_tail_damage: A single transient breach can eject eventual recoveries and right-tail holdings.
counterfactual_families.targeted_failure_pattern: Loss accumulated before the current individual exit executes.

counterfactual_families.causal_claim: The frozen MA30 x2 trigger is still too sensitive to a transient security-specific break.
counterfactual_families.exact_intervention: Defer or cancel the exit unless the below-MA condition remains persistent under an independently fixed state transition.
counterfactual_families.falsification_criterion: Reject if the independently specified persistence state does not isolate transient signals without using post-exit recovery knowledge.
counterfactual_families.potential_right_tail_damage: A delayed exit can deepen already-material losses.
counterfactual_families.targeted_failure_pattern: False individual exits followed by a causal signal reversal.

counterfactual_families.causal_claim: An individual trend break has different meaning under supportive versus weak market-anchor state.
counterfactual_families.decision_point: Current individual exit signal after the completed market-anchor close.
counterfactual_families.exact_intervention: Condition individual-exit admission on an independently specified existing market-gate state.
counterfactual_families.falsification_criterion: Reject if the preregistered market-state direction does not isolate the targeted weak lineage or if it merely reproduces market exit.
parameters_required: semantic direction: suppress under supportive market or suppress under weak market
counterfactual_families.potential_right_tail_damage: Either direction can retain deteriorating names or remove idiosyncratic recoveries.
counterfactual_families.targeted_failure_pattern: Security-specific weakness whose causal interpretation depends on market context.

counterfactual_families.causal_claim: The individual exit module should be removed and positions should wait for market exit.
counterfactual_families.exact_intervention: Disable individual exit and its downstream set removal.
counterfactual_families.falsification_criterion: Already addressed as a basic module ablation on a different sample; repeating it does not identify the HYP-003 interaction.
counterfactual_families.potential_right_tail_damage: Weak holdings can remain until portfolio-level market exit.
counterfactual_families.targeted_failure_pattern: All individual exits, not the HYP-003 cohort specifically.

counterfactual_families.causal_claim: Individual exits should differ by current profit, MFE, or giveback state.
counterfactual_families.exact_intervention: Suppress or accelerate individual exit using a position-path threshold.
counterfactual_families.falsification_criterion: Reject any rule whose threshold is selected from the realized winner/loser path.
counterfactual_families.potential_right_tail_damage: Path thresholds can turn the strategy into a tuned stop or winner-hold rule.
counterfactual_families.targeted_failure_pattern: Negative marks versus profitable giveback cases.

counterfactual_families.causal_claim: A removed symbol should be re-entered after an individual exit proves transient.
counterfactual_families.exact_intervention: Permit special re-entry after a recovery condition.
counterfactual_families.falsification_criterion: Reject any definition based on knowing the later recovery or winner outcome.
inputs_known_at_decision: future completed closes only when they later occur
counterfactual_families.potential_right_tail_damage: Adds fitted path dependence and portfolio crowding changes.

counterfactual_families.causal_claim: Changing precedence between individual exit and set removal changes the exit outcome.
counterfactual_families.decision_point: Current individual signal and desired-set construction.
counterfactual_families.exact_intervention: Relabel or reorder individual signal and set removal.
counterfactual_families.falsification_criterion: The frozen engine proves set removal is downstream of forced_exits and is the scheduling mechanism, so precedence-only changes do not define an independent exit.
counterfactual_families.potential_right_tail_damage: None if label-only; equivalent to disabling the individual exit if removal is suppressed.

exact_missing_identification_evidence: A parameter-free, independently specified semantic objective for the individual exit: early loss containment, persistence confirmation, or market-conditioned interpretation.

An independently frozen precedence/state-transition rule that selects exactly one direction for the existing market gate and individual signal without using realized recovery or candidate performance.
If persistence is intended, an externally justified confirmation and cancellation definition fixed without choosing among 1/2/3/5-session alternatives.
No current frozen evidence supplies a causal no-exit control; the poor realized bucket can mean the signal identifies already-weak holdings rather than that the exit causes the loss.
hyp003_identification.frozen_39_cycle_definition: A completed V1 cycle whose final exit signal date is present in both INDIVIDUAL_EXIT_SIGNAL and previous-minus-desired removal sets, after canonical_exit_reason gives precedence only to raw reasons exactly equal to a single market reason.

lineage_correction.root_cause: canonical_exit_reason recognizes only raw == MARKET_MA20_X2 or raw == MARKET_CLOSE_LT_MA20_X0.96; the combined market-reason string falls through to the individual-plus-removal label.

pairwise_non_discrimination.why_frozen_evidence_cannot_discriminate: The same weak realized bucket supports opposite stories: the exit may arrive too late after loss has accumulated, or it may be a timely response that would become worse if delayed. No frozen no-exit control resolves the sign.
Loss at the second close does not identify whether timing or market context is causal; market-supportive and market-weak states both admit coherent but opposite interpretations.
Both can suppress a subset of current exits, but the observed exit outcome contains no causal evidence selecting a persistence window or a market-state direction.

second_confirmation_session.interpretation: Mixed-direction incremental evidence; most median loss already existed before the second confirmation, so it does not uniquely justify advancing or delaying the exit.

hyp003_identification.per_cycle_storage_policy: Do not duplicate the full frozen ledgers or daily paths; retain exact cohort identities and hash bindings so all fields reconstruct deterministically from the registered source artifacts.
hyp003_identification.structural_causal_finding: The observed bucket is endogenous to the exit rule: own_exit_signal adds the symbol to forced_exits, desired-set construction excludes forced_exits, and that membership transition schedules the sell. The two labels do not identify two independent causal exit components.
